We're a registered 501c3 non-profit (EIN 83-4274095). 

Founded by 3 girls from Australia, England and Ireland, whilst living in China. We're just trying to save as many animals as we possibly can, and bring greater animal welfare and support to Harbin and the surrounding areas in China. Working with locals and the authorities to make it a safer, kinder and happier place for all species. 

We have been rescuing in China for over 8 years. 

Our Instagram is  @Slaughterhouse_survivors for daily content and live videos.

We have over 1000 animals currently in our care at our Safehouse facility:

Visit our website for more info:
